title: TriMas Packaging to Exhibit at Automechanika Shanghai 2026
summary: Discover luxury packaging innovation and sustainable product solutions by visiting us at LUXE PACK Monaco 2023, the premier show for creative packaging, from October 2nd to 4th, 2023.
body_markdown:
## **Highlighting innovative dispensing and closure solutions for automotive lubricants, fluids and specialty chemicals**


TriMas Packaging is pleased to announce its participation at[Automechanika Shanghai](https://automechanika-shanghai.hk.messefrankfurt.com/shanghai/en.html) , one of Asia’s largest and most influential automotive trade fairs, taking place December 2–5 at the National Exhibition and Convention Center (NECC) in Shanghai, China. Visitors can meet the TriMas Packaging team at **Booth 2.2H88** to explore innovative dispensing and closure designed for automotive lubricants, fluids and specialty chemicals.


### **Solutions Designed for Performance and Protection**


At this year’s exhibition, TriMas Packaging will showcase a broad portfolio of dispensing and closure technologies engineered for automotive lubricants, additives, fluids and other industrial chemical products. Designed to perform throughout the supply chain, these solutions provide **secure sealing, reliable dispensing and protection against leakage and contamination** .


**Featured Solutions include:**


- Pull-out spout closures
- Screw caps
- Press-fit screw closures
- FLEXSPOUT® closures for larger containers and drums
- Drum faucets and dispensing systems
- Specialty closures
- Custom-engineered packaging solutions


These solutions can be customized to meet a variety of customer requirements, including **leak prevention, e-commerce compliance, child resistance, anti-counterfeiting measures and FM-certified applications** .


### **Global Expertise, Local Support**


A key focus of the TriMas Packaging exhibit will be our ability to develop **customized and localized packaging solutions** that address regional market requirements and unique customer needs. By combining global engineering expertise with local manufacturing, technical expertise and customer support, TriMas Packaging helps customers accelerate speed to market, enhance product performance and create differentiated packaging solutions.


### **Visit TriMas Packaging at Booth 2.2H88 to discover how our innovative packaging solutions help automotive lubricant, fluid and chemical brands enhance product protection, improve user experience and differentiate their products in a competitive marketplace.**
